body.message:
Thank you for your continued trust in us—it truly means a lot to have you as a long-term guest.

While our standard rate for 30 nights is AED 10,000/month, we have reviewed your request and as a gesture of appreciation, we are happy to offer you a special rate of AED 8,500 — which is the best we can offer you.

We hope this works for you, and we look forward to welcoming you back!
